recent.text: Allen Graves in his first NBA start: 20 points (previous career-high: 13), 10 rebounds (previous high: 6), 3 steals (previous high: 1), team-best +12 in 32 minutes. Can't put the genie back in the bottle. The rook needs to be out there, whether the Raptors are healthy or not.
